summary: Implemented src/engine/evaluate.ts, exporting evaluateHealth(datasets, policies, asOf) as the integration test expects. It also exports evaluateFreshness, evaluateSchema and resolveThreshold. Unit tests are in test/engine/evaluate.test.ts, and all 5 pass with `node --test test/engine/*.test.ts`.
remaining_uncertainty: I did not run test/integration/pipeline.test.ts, because the report module (src/report) belongs to another workstream and shell commands other than node --test were not available to me.
The boundary rule (staleness equal to the threshold counts as fresh) is my choice. The hidden acceptance tests may assume otherwise.

The records carry no schema-version field, because the pinned HealthRecord contract has none. The AC-CONTRACT 'schema version' and 'last_update' fields would have to come from the report/adapter layer.
